criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact input handoff needs while mapping capability coverage
missing or nonmatching needs remain visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the allowed record set and maps exact need text to matching capabilities, leaving missing matches as unsupported sentinels. The final coverage table matches the supplied needs/capabilities relationship: six direct matches and two unsupported needs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
preserve missing or contradictory evidence visibility

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. That makes covered capability matches rank before genuinely unsupported needs, contradicting the boundary role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs. This is behaviorally significant because the first priority and downstream recommendation are selected from this misordered table.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation appears internally consistent with its declared role: it retains the eight-item priority window and derives the recommendation from the first ranked row. However, its input priorities are already corrupted by the upstream prioritization boundary, so its reported recommendation inherits that fault and should not be trusted as an end-to-end outcome.
